knowledge_graph.title: Reagan High School
knowledge_graph.type: High school in San Antonio, Texas
knowledge_graph.description: Ronald Reagan High School is a public high school located in the North East Independent School District in San Antonio, Texas, United States, and named after U.S. President Ronald Reagan. The school serves a portion of Timberwood Park and Stone Oak.
knowledge_graph.address: 19000 Ronald Reagan Dr, San Antonio, TX 78258
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Reagan High School offers engaging 9th through 12th grade education and athletics to the San Antonio community. As a part of NEISD, accredited academics and student growth are the priorities of the curriculum."

text_blocks.snippet: Ronald Reagan High School is a public high school located in San Antonio, Texas, part of the North East Independent School District (NEISD).

list.snippet: Address: 19000 Ronald Reagan Drive, San Antonio, TX 78258
Official Website: You can visit the Reagan High School Official Website for calendars, staff directories, and announcements.
Ratings: The school routinely performs above the state average, earning an "A" rating from the Texas Education Agency and ranking in the upper tier of high schools in Texas.
Programs: Offers extensive Advanced Placement (AP) courses, a Gifted & Talented program, and various career and technical education options.
